title: The Day of Resurrection
description: The Day of Resurrection in Tonic Solfa to ELLACOMBE: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses, and a piano.
about: John Mason Neale’s English translation of this Greek Easter hymn by John of Damascus was published in 1862. The tune ELLACOMBE comes from a hymn book of the ducal court chapel of Württemberg (1784).
underlay: The day of_ re-sur-rec_-tion! Earth, tell_ it out a-broad; The Pass-o_-ver of glad_-ness, The Pass_-o-ver of God. From_ death to life e-ter__-nal, From_ earth un-to the sky, Our Christ hath_ brought us o_-ver, With hymns_ of vic-to-ry.

lines: Our Christ hath brought us over,
Our hearts be pure from evil,
May hear, so calm and plain,
Now let the heav’ns be joyful!
Let the round world keep triumph,
Let all things seen and unseen
For Christ the Lord hath risen,
Our joy that hath no end.
